versions.changelog:
ecommerce-video-script-generator v1.1.0

- Initial release.
- Generates 10s/15s structured e-commerce video storyboards from product selling points, category, function, user pain point, target market, etc.
- Outputs both JSON (for AI pipeline) and Markdown (for human review).
- Follows fixed shot structures and category/function-specific rules for all supported video types and target countries.
- Supports detailed mapping from user pain points to camera strategies.
- CLI and chat environment supported, with customizable output paths.
